fields.title: 📖 Faith and rejection have different ends
fields.body:
🖋️ **Allah ʿazza wa jalla:**

> ***“Allah promised the believers who do righteous deeds forgiveness and a tremendous reward; and He warned those who deny and declare His signs to be a lie.”***

🌙 **Conclusion:** The series must preserve both sides: hope for faith and repentance, and warning against denial and rejection.
